runtime: wrangler pages dev (Pages functions) + wrangler dev (Worker) + vite dev proxy, local

checks.name: the site and the Worker name their release from the same origin
a public read reaches the Worker through the Pages function
the caller's bearer token is forwarded on a read (signed-in 200, signed-out 401)
a protected write: a signed-in non-dictator is refused by the database (403), a missing session by the Worker (401)

answers.message: division must be a division slug, for example super-league
